changes: POST /api/v1/org/aiRouter/capture/{projectUuid} — api path removed without deprecation

declaredAdvisories.reason: The dashboard capture router is removed: Design Mode sends a dashboard's marks straight to an AI agent, so nothing sorts a recording into layout changes any more. POST /api/v1/org/aiRouter/capture/{projectUuid} now returns 404, and @lightdash/common no longer exports ApiCaptureRouteRequest, ApiCaptureRouteResponse or the capture routing types. The route served only dashboard Voice Design, which was behind the dashboard-capture feature flag; the flag is off by default on Cloud and on self-hosted, and the web app's dashboard page was the only caller. During a rolling update an old dashboard tab with the flag on fails to sort a recording until refresh; nothing is written or lost.
